description: Chaozhou Three-Circle (Group) Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of electronic ceramic electronic components and basic materials in China and internationally. The company offers precision ceramic structural components, such as high-performance and high-precision ceramic structural components for the electronics industry and others; and components, including multilayer chip ceramic capacitors, as well as lead resistors of various sizes, temperature characteristics, and withstand voltage levels.
